title.headline: Sixty lawyers. One set of house positions.

end.line: Quillon for Marlowe Kent’s banking and finance group

vo: Marlowe Kent's sixty borrower-side banking lawyers start every first draft by reconciling the term sheet to precedent.
In Word, Quillon redlines the draft to your house positions, with each change explained against the playbook.
Those positions are remembered from your closed matters, so partners never have to write the memo.
And any question across the facility documents comes back answered, cited to the page.
Priya will walk your team through it on Friday the twenty-first.
